name: Swipe actions (iOS)
summary: Buttons revealed by swiping a list row sideways, for quick actions such as delete, flag or archive.

anatomy.purpose: 1 to 3 colored buttons with icon and label.
Swiping all the way triggers the first action.

whenNotToUse: The only way to reach an action: also provide it in the detail screen or edit mode.

keyboard: VoiceOver offers actions through the rotor.
accessibility.focus: Actions are exposed as custom accessibility actions.
notes: Never hide the only path to an action.
Destructive full swipe needs a confirmation or undo.

code.html:
Meeting notes
Swipe left or press the left arrow for actions.
code.frame:
Meeting notes
Swipe left or press the left arrow for actions.
